decision: Re-establish the stock control with the first immutable complete GLM-4.7-Flash checkpoint after correcting v12's remote-directory ownership defect.

causal_hypothesis.primary: With the transfer target created by sudo and owned by the SSH user, the already verified complete 48-shard checkpoint will reach the pinned runtime, materially improve the frozen absolute quality screen relative to the malformed 44-shard result, and retain the fixed 8K/1K H100 service SLO.
causal_hypothesis.expected_direction: The new transfer probe and stream pass; complete-checkpoint quality improves substantially; throughput remains in the same broad range because the configured architecture was already executed.
causal_hypothesis.falsification_value: A complete hash-verified checkpoint that cannot fit, fails the frozen quality screen, or misses the SLO rejects the corresponding one-H100 stock claim.
